Ben / team —

Pulling together high-level numbers based on the call notes and the sample prompts you gave Scott. I attached a PDF with the full per-model breakdown (model_memory_breakdown.pdf). Key items up front:

Summary (assumptions):
- Target traffic: steady 15 concurrent requests / average, with bursts to 60.
- Primary models: Llama-3-Chat-70B (production), Mistral-40B (aux), small reranker 3B.
- Typical context: 2k tokens; 95th percentile context: 6k tokens; archival / long reads occasionally up to 12k tokens.

Sizing highlights (per live request):
- Llama-3-Chat-70B (fp16 weights + KV): model weights ~28GB (fp16), KV cache for 6k context ~22GB => total ~50GB resident per concurrent inference.
- With 4-bit quantization (s4/awq-style): weights drop to ~9GB; total resident per inference drops to ~31GB (KV still dominates at large contexts).
- Mistral-40B: fp16 weights ~18GB; KV @6k ~12GB => total ~30GB; 4-bit weights ~6GB => total ~18GB.
- Reranker 3B: negligible relative to big models, fits comfortably with batching on same cards.

How KV cache scales:
- KV cache ~ O(context_length * hidden_state_size). For our estimates we used per-token KV ~3.5KB for 70B-class (reasonable approximation).
- Doubling context roughly doubles KV footprint, so supporting 12k contexts increases the per-request resident memory by ~2x for KV portion.

Fleet mapping / recommendations (two options):
1) Canary / pilot (3-month):
  - 4 x H100-80GB nodes (gives ~320GB aggregate GPU mem). Run 70B quantized (4-bit) for most traffic; keep fp16 variant as on-call fallback in different pool. Estimated concurrency headroom ~40 steady with aggressive batching and KV cache sharing.
2) Committed baseline (12-month recommended for price):
  - 8 x H100-80GB reserved for production. Config: mixed pool (6 for 70B quantized primary, 2 for fp16 fallbacks and long-tail 12k contexts). This gives predictable throughput for ~15 steady / bursts to 100 with prefix/KV caching enabled.

Notes on perf vs precision:
- 4-bit quantization reduces GPU weight memory by ~60–70% (major wins) and typically reduces DRAM transfers too, improving throughput.
- However, quantization increases CPU/GPU prep overhead a bit and can slightly increase token latency in some models; for EW's Llama-3-Chat-70B tests we estimate p95 latency increase of ~5–12% over fp16 for same hardware, but cost per token drops by ~40–60%.

Operational levers we recommend:
- Enable prefix/KV cache at the edge for long-running sessions to amortize KV across requests.
- Serve long-context >8k on a separate fp16 pool to avoid reserving large resident mem for all requests.
- Use aggressive batching on quantized models for bulk throughput paths (async inference routes).

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm the P95 SLO and monthly commit target so I can map to a monthly $ estimate.
- Run a short perf sweep (we can schedule a 2-hour bench session) to validate latency delta for your exact prompts.

Will attach the detailed spreadsheet and the PDF breakdown to the HubSpot deal.

—Marissa

Scott —

Quick answers up front and a proposed mapping to committed spend bands. We can do the perf sweep Tue 6/6 1:30pm PST — Marissa, can you confirm bench slot?

Latency & precision
- Short answer: yes, with tuning. 4-bit quantized 70B on H100 with aggressive batching and our optimized kernels can hit p95 ~350–420ms for single-turns at your target concurrency in lab; in production you should budget ~10–15% overhead for routing and network jitter.

Routing for contexts
- Proposal: mixed-pool routing:
  - Quantized primary pool for up to 3k contexts (covers most customer traffic).
  - Small fp16 fallback pool (separate reservation) for >3k and rare 12k requests.
  - A prefix/KV cache layer in front to reduce repeated long-context cost for conversational sessions.

Mapped committed spend (ballpark; includes reserved HW + support):
- Pilot (4 H100 reserved, 3-month commitment): estimated committed spend ~ $28k / month.
- Mid committed (8 H100 reserved, 12-month): estimated committed spend ~ $64k / month. Includes a default 10% discount on list reserved pricing.
- Aggressive (12 H100 reserved for peak headroom + fp16 pool): estimated committed spend ~ $96k / month.

Given your $45k–$90k target, the mid committed plan maps cleanly to ~8 H100s. We can tune the discount and headroom to land inside your target.

Next steps
1) Marissa to run perf sweep (Tue 6/6 1:30pm PST).
2) Scott to confirm desired P95 SLO (450ms confirmed in this thread).
3) If SLO confirmed, we’ll put together a formal mutual action plan and contract sketch; pricing will be finalized after the perf sweep.
